title: Jelly Roll as a bandleader
summary: Clem describes Jelly as temperamental, docking pay for lateness, which led to the break with Dink.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: That's jolly hard to get along with, would you say? Or is it eccentric, that is? I mean, reliable?

Well, most musicians, I think, being in charge of a group is somewhat temperamental. As I say, he always wants you there on time, but he could come in a few minutes late. Yeah. Naturally, he couldn't say anything. No. But if you late, well, he'd dock it, take it out. It's sound. He was that type of a fellow. That's why he and Dink couldn't get along. You know, Dink used to be the drummer with him. Yeah. And Dink, he tried to organize a little group, but they didn't do no good.
Can you tell about your first experiences when you came up here and played at the Barbary?
